name: PICO
summary: PICO formed through the merger of PICASSO and COUPP. Its fluorocarbon superheated-liquid bubble chambers primarily probe spin-dependent WIMP–proton interactions.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils trigger bubbles in superheated liquid. Cameras and acoustic signals locate and identify events, while temperature and pressure set the nuclear-recoil threshold.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
